scope: Angola medical discovery — Universidade Privada de Angola Medicine

verifiedFacts.claim: UPRA's 2025/26 official tuition schedule lists Medicine basic-cycle tuition of AOA 253,368 and says clinical-cycle fees are set by the signed contract; the schedule identifies the Faculty of Health Sciences.
UPRA's official 2025/26 vacancy document lists 500 authorised Medicine places and labels Medicine as accredited.

UPRA's official academic regulation says the Medicine degree lasts six years and awards Licenciado em Medicina; its curriculum includes supervised final-year placements in internal medicine, general surgery, paediatrics, obstetrics and gynaecology, and public health.

holdReasons: The fee schedule is for 2025/26 rather than a confirmed active 2026/27 intake, and the clinical-cycle price is contract-dependent; it cannot support a complete public fee card.
The available admissions guide is older and does not establish a complete current application window, document checklist, or international-applicant route.

The reviewed sources do not clearly establish instructional language, named clinical sites, scholarship/loan support, accommodation, or graduate-registration pathway. The university's own vacancy label is useful evidence but needs a current regulator-facing accreditation record before a commercial recognition claim.
nextAction: Obtain UPRA's active admissions guide and full fee contract/schedule, then verify teaching language, clinical partners, regulator record and student-support arrangements before packaging content.
